title: haselSMP
description: Just a simple survival SMP with op items events.
body: Tired of the other Minecraft servers? I gotcha because the server has started only today and the Ender Dragon has not been beaten yet. The server features a huge 15k x 15k blocks in the overworld, 5000x5000 in the nether and 10k by 10k in the end. I am still looking for people who can help me decorate the spawn even more. Also fight in events to get the op SWORD that has +1000 attack damage and insane reach ability. Hope you enjoy the server!
